positives.branch_callback_write: Branch-valued callback body writes Int32 into an initially UInt8 captured local; post-call overload reports the resulting type.
positives.call_valued_initial_binding: A source method call initializes the captured local before Proc.new writes an Int32 value.
positives.method_parameter_capture_write: A Proc.new callback assigns an Int32 value into a captured UInt8 method parameter.
positives.multiline_main_owner_capture: The top-level owner contains intervening typed local assignments around a Proc.new callback, testing whole-owner collection rather than adjacency.
positives.nested_callback_write: An inner Proc callback writes a parameter value into a local captured by the enclosing Proc callback.
positives.ordinary_block_parameter_shadow: An ordinary method block parameter named like the outer UInt8 local is reassigned; the outer local must remain UInt8.
positives.parenthesized_call_initial_binding: Parenthesized initial call preserves callback write constraints.
positives.copied_call_initial_binding: Initial value copied from a late-typed call preserves callback write constraints.
positives.conditional_call_initial_binding: Conditional call-valued initializer preserves callback write constraints.

scope: Lexical capture ownership and mutation; original-first runtime comparison is required.
limitations: Focused no-prelude controls do not establish arbitrary capture inference or whole-application parity.
